item.title: The Brisbane buildings made from sandstone touched by dinosaurs
item.description: Fossilised footprints belonging to 230-million-year-old dinosaurs have been unearthed in Brisbane, indented into the same sandstone that constructed the city's most recognisable buildings. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: A dead star is flashing radio waves every 8 minutes, and its partner looks a lot like the sun
item.description: Since 2022, astronomers have been puzzling over a new kind of cosmic object called long-period radio transients. These are objects that emit bright flashes of radio waves into space every few minutes to every few hours. Some have been traced back to binary systems consisting of a small, dim, cool star called a red dwarf in orbit with a stellar remnant called a white dwarf. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Indiana appeals court revises child support, awards father $15,275 and restores mother's obligation
item.description: In a recent case, a father requested modifications to his child support payments after both daughters moved in with him. This resulted in financial arguments and disputes over parenting-time credits involving their mother. The Indiana Court of Appeals intervened, rectifying the original court's miscalculations of the father's overpayment. The court underscored that even if children are estranged, the duty to provide support remains. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Fact check: 'Iranian' content farms reach millions
item.description: Several social media accounts claiming to represent the Iranian military show signs of being part of so-called content farms. DW Fact Check looks at how they operate and how users can spot them. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: NFL Hall of Famer Fran Tarkenton buys $51.89 million Palm Beach mansion; sellers had paid $12.65 million in 2019
item.description: Fran Tarkenton, the legendary NFL quarterback, has made headlines by acquiring a beautifully renovated Mediterranean mansion in Palm Beach for $51.89 million. This stunning property boasts five spacious bedrooms and breathtaking ocean views, complemented by exclusive beach access. Having spent considerable time in the Palm Beach area, Tarkenton now joins a select group of affluent buyers captivated by the island's luxurious real estate offerings. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Scientists scooped 11 endangered alpine spiny crayfish from a Victorian creek after bushfires
item.description: In January 2026, bushfires in Victoria threatened the alpine spiny crayfish, prompting a rescue effort by scientists. The 11 crayfish were taken to Snobs Creek conservation hatchery to recover after being rescued from dangerous waters. They faced various challenges in captivity, such as aggression towards each other, requiring individual care plans. As scientists monitor the waterways, future conservation efforts may include captive breeding programs for the species. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: When people entered a cave in Chiapas, Mexico, in 2012, they found 165 human skulls
item.description: In a remarkable discovery, a total of 165 human skulls was unearthed in a cave located in Chiapas, Mexico, shedding light on ancient Mesoamerican rituals. Dating back around 1,000 years to the Early Postclassic period, these remains included notably women and children. The research indicates that the cave could have served as a pilgrimage site, reflecting a sophisticated system of rituals connected to ancient Maya beliefs regarding the human body. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk
